Subject: Scheduling product demo — timezone + holiday conflicts

Hi Kentaro / Priya,

Thanks again for taking time to coordinate a demo. We want to make sure we have the right stakeholders from Japan, India, and EMEA on the call — aware that regional holidays and daylight saving differences sometimes make scheduling tricky.

Attached is the latest DemoDeck (v2) for background — it's light, mostly screenshots and examples.

A few proposed slots (all shown with local equivalents below):
- Option A: 2026-07-06 09:00 PDT / 16:00 BST / 00:00 JST (next day)
- Option B: 2026-07-07 17:00 PDT / 01:00 BST (next day) / 09:00 JST
- Option C: 2026-07-15 10:00 UTC / 11:00 BST / 19:30 IST / 19:00 JST

Quick notes:
- We're intentionally including a UTC-based option (Option C) to avoid cross-region DST confusion — local offsets can shift depending on daylight saving changes between regions.
- If any of your teams have planned OOO windows (Golden Week, Diwali, Easter-related closures, company retreats), let us know so we avoid those dates.

Can you confirm which option works, or propose two windows that suit your local teams? Once we agree I'll send a calendar invite (locked to UTC) so no one gets different times as DST rules change later in the year.

Thanks — looking forward to it.

Best,
Marissa Cole

Marissa —

Thanks for the deck and the options. A couple of things from the Japan side: several members of our platform team will be OOO for an internal conference/office closure from 2026-07-06 through 2026-07-09 (we've been calling this our summer golden-week shutdown internally). That rules out Option A and makes Option B difficult.

Option C on 2026-07-15 looks promising for our Tokyo team (morning JST is best). If you could move to that week, mornings JST or late evening PDT works.

We're also mindful of potential DST effects — we prefer invites that are anchored in UTC so local calendar clients do the conversion.
